name: terminal
description: An animated terminal that types out a script of commands and output — for demos, onboarding and agent transcripts

meta.name: Terminal
meta.description: An animated terminal that types out a script of commands and output — for demos, onboarding and agent transcripts

props.name: lines
props.description: The script. Each line has `text`, an optional `prefix` (e.g. `$`) and a `type` (`command | output | error | comment`, default `output`).

props.name: loop
props.description: Restart from the first line after the last one.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called each time the last line finishes typing.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n) — `label` names the terminal for screen readers.

fields.name: prefix
fields.description: A prompt marker such as `$`, styled and not selectable.

examples.title: Install transcript
examples.code:
<Terminal
  lines={[
    { text: 'npx cascivo add button', prefix: '$', type: 'command' },
    { text: 'Added button to src/components.', type: 'output' },
    { text: '# done in 1.2s', type: 'comment' },
  ]}
/>

whenToUse: Demonstrating a CLI or agent run on a marketing or onboarding page
Replaying a short agent transcript as it happened

antiPatterns.bad: Putting aria-live on the typing lines
antiPatterns.good: Keep the animation aria-hidden and the full script as text, as Terminal does
antiPatterns.why: A live region on per-character typing announces fragments on every frame

related.name: LogViewer
related.reason: LogViewer is for real, streaming logs with search and follow

related.name: CodeSnippet
related.reason: CodeSnippet is for static, copyable commands

intent.a11yRationale: A named group whose full script is present as visually hidden text from the first render, read once in order; the typing animation is aria-hidden, so a screen reader is never fed per-character fragments. The cursor blinks only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; colours come from the editor tokens and fall back to CanvasText in forced colours

flexibility.note: Follows the editor tokens; override --cascivo-terminal-bg / -fg for an always-dark look
